sourceEvidence.title: Manufacturing Engineer
sourceEvidence.quote: Manufacturing Engineering Lead (Hydraulic Cylinder Production) Leads site manufacturing engineering for hydraulic cylinder production, directing process design and continuous improvement across welding , machining , assembly , testing , and painting . Key Responsibilities Own process design, optimization, and troubleshooting across the full manufacturing value stream. Support product launches by ensuring manufacturability and process readiness. Drive lean initiatives and process standardization to improve quality and efficiency. Lead automation and engineering improvements to enhance throughput and capability. Establish and maintain engineering data governance to ensure traceability and consistency. Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional production teams to align on execution and improvements. Required Qualifications & Skills Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes for hydraulic cylinder components. Ability to lead process improvement, root-cause analysis, and technical problem-solving. Experience with lean methods, automation concepts, and engineering data management. Demonstrated understanding of quality systems and ISO 9001. Strong cross-functional communication and leadership skills.
